name: the Parliament
about: Veridia's large circular parliament building in Meldan, reached by a tree-lined path (chapters 8, 17 and 32). The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Gladias started walking forward along a path covered with trees on both sides.
facts.fact: Approached along a path covered by trees.

facts.quote: he saw a large circular building ahead. This was the parliament.
it was on ground level, the construction mixing medieval and modern aesthetics, with multiple entrances on all sides
facts.fact: At ground level, mixing medieval and modern styles, with entrances on all sides.

facts.quote: When he arrived at a side door of the building, he tapped his watch on the green circle.
facts.fact: Side doors open with a green circle.

facts.quote: Twenty senators were sitting on large chairs arranged along the whole edge of the circular-shaped room
facts.fact: Inside, a circular hearing room ringed by senators' chairs.

facts.quote: some bright yellow lights to light up the room, and a few faint violet-looking lights to keep the air clean
facts.fact: Bright yellow lights and faint violet air-cleaning lights.

facts.quote: Do you want to go upstairs and check out the roof?
They were already partway up the mountain, about forty meters higher than most of the rest of Meldan.
facts.fact: It sits partway up the mountain, above most of the city.

descriptor: a large circular parliament hall at ground level on a low mountain shoulder, a ring of medieval-style pale stone arches and buttresses wrapped in curving bands of modern glass, with many entrances all around, a planted roof terrace, faint green lights by its doors, and a long straight footpath leading to it under tall leafy trees, in pale stone, sage, cream and gold
plate_prompt: Establishing view of large circular parliament hall at ground level on a low mountain shoulder, a ring of medieval-style pale stone arches and buttresses wrapped in curving bands of modern glass, with many entrances all around, a planted roof terrace, faint green lights by its doors, and a long straight footpath leading to it under tall leafy trees, in pale stone, sage, cream and gold. Seen from the footpath on a calm sunny morning, the building framed at the end of the trees, the forested mountain rising behind under a pastel sky. No people in the foreground.
